sentences.en: When she became a nun, she took the name Sister Teresa.
sentences.zh: 当她成为修女时，她取名为特蕾莎修女。

sentences.en: She led a group of nuns called the Missionaries of Charity.
sentences.zh: 她领导了一群被称为仁爱传教修女会的修女。

sentences.en: The nun is fine, but I liked the other one more.
sentences.zh: 这位修女很好，但我更喜欢另一个。
